XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sudden blockage of the gearbox in neutral while driving, with the relevant fault light coming on.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with an automatic gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Component: Gear lever position sensor

  • Fault: The gearbox became stuck in neutral whilst driving on the road; subsequently, the corresponding gearbox fault warning light also came on

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • U0103 (CAN data bus – Gear selector control unit Loss of communication)
    • P0914 (Control circuit, gear selector position – Fault)
    • P1734 (Fault/deactivation – Gear lever position sensor)
  • Cause: Faulty gear lever position sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the gear lever position sensor and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: After replacing the component, no adjustment was necessary using a self-diagnostic tester.
    The sensor in question is hooked onto the gear lever and is supplied complete with fixing screws and wiring.
